intent: A customer's billing schedule in a kit Card, one closed view: full (all charges in one Table), nextOnly (the next charge and its card) or failed (the open failed payment). Each view has its own empty, loading and error.
useWhen: a dashboard card with the next charge — view="nextOnly"
an account page that flags a failed payment — view="failed"
billing settings with the full charge table — view="full"
doNotUseWhen: one invoice or credit note as a document — InvoiceDocument
choosing or changing a plan — PricingPlans
a generic list of rows with no billing meaning — Table

view.note: Closed. full: every charge, upcoming first (oldest first) then billed (newest first). nextOnly: the next-charge panel. failed: the open failed charge first, then invoiced or retrying charges.

charges.note: { id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), label, amount (pre-formatted), value?, status, invoice?, note?, splitLabel? }[]. status: scheduled, retrying, invoiced, paid, failed or waived. full and failed read it.

next.note: { date, amount, paysWith }, all pre-formatted. nextOnly reads it; without it nextOnly shows its empty state.

description.note: The Card description beside the title, such as the plan name.

failureDetail.note: The failure Alert's body: what was declined, when the retry runs and what to do before then.

emptyDescription.note: The empty state's one line. Defaults per view.

loading.note: full and failed: the Table loading state (header plus Skeleton rows). nextOnly: the panel with Skeleton lines.

error.note: What failed to load. A danger Alert titled for the view.

onRetry.note: Retry (outline, RotateCcw) in the error Alert.

onAsk.note: Ask (outline, MessageCircle) in the Card header.

onDownloadAll.note: full only: Download all (ghost) in the Card header, hidden while the failure Alert shows.

onEditCharge.note: (charge) => void. full only: an edit pencil on scheduled rows, named "Edit <label>, <date>". Open your own edit form.

onDownloadInvoice.note: (charge) => void. A Download icon on billed rows, named by the invoice.

onChangeCard.note: nextOnly: Change card (outline) at the end of the panel.

onUpdateCard.note: full and failed: Update card in the failure Alert, the one solid primary.

requirements: The Card is an article named by its Billing schedule heading
Status is a word in a kit Badge (Upcoming, Retrying, Invoiced, Paid, Failed, Waived), never colour alone
The next charge says Next charge in words after its description
Row actions are icon Buttons named with the charge and date, or the invoice
The nextOnly panel is a section named Next charge
aria-busy on the Card while loading; Skeletons announce Loading once
A load error and an open failed payment are kit Alerts (danger) with the amount and date in the failure title

doNot: Do not rebuild a local billing schedule, charges table or next-charge card; use this component
Do not split upcoming and billed charges into two tables
Do not add a second solid primary; Update card in the failure Alert is the one
Do not reach into Card, Table, Badge or Alert markup to restyle them
Do not format money in the component; pass amounts pre-formatted
snippet:
<BillingSchedule view="full" charges={charges} description="Pro plan" onDownloadAll={downloadAll} onUpdateCard={updateCard} />
<BillingSchedule view="nextOnly" next={{ date: "01 Dec 2026", amount: "$480.00", paysWith: "Visa ending 4242" }} description="Pro plan" onChangeCard={changeCard} />
<BillingSchedule view="failed" charges={charges} description="Pro plan" failureDetail="The card was declined. We retry on 04 Oct 2026, so update it before then to keep the plan active." onUpdateCard={updateCard} />
